_comment: Pterodactyl Egg Export for Cipher License
name: Cipher License Bot
author: silas@astrox.net
description: Production-grade licensing Discord bot and REST validate server for Minecraft plugins.
startup: if [ ! -f .env ]; then touch .env; fi && if [ -f package.json ]; then npm install && npm start; else echo "Missing package.json"; exit 1; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installation script for Cipher License
apt update && apt install -y git curl
npm install -g pnpm
pnpm --version

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: The token for authentication with the Discord Gateway.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: The Application / Client ID for your Discord Bot.

variables.name: Guild ID
variables.description: Target Discord Server ID for command registration.

variables.name: Admin Role ID
variables.description: Role allowed to execute admin-level slash commands.

variables.name: MongoDB URI
variables.description: Connection string for the MongoDB instance.

variables.name: HMAC Secret
variables.description: Min 32 character cryptographic key for signature signing.

variables.name: API Listen Port
variables.description: The port the Fastify validate handshake server listens on.

variables.name: Discord Log Channel ID
variables.description: Discord Channel ID where license validation/login logs are sent (optional).
